subject: Ask for the meaning of A1/A2 in two.b.pls output

messages.author: 96a78639336ed702
messages.subject: Ask for the meaning of A1/A2 in two.b.pls output
parts:
Dear all,

The geomorph user manual interprets the A1 and A2 output from two.b.pls as "Input values for the left/right block". While I could understand XScores/YScores and singular vectors from the output of two.b.pls, I have difficulty undersanding A1/A2. Can anyone help explain A1/A2 in PLS output? Thank you.

Best regards,
Lv

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Ask for the meaning of A1/A2 in two.b.pls output
parts:
Please reread the help page. The inputs for two.b.pls include 2 blocks of variables, which are called (in the help file) A1 and A2.
